spec.skirt_f: m = mean(pitch_l, pitch_r); pitch = CAP*tanh(K*m/CAP) if m > 0 else K_IN*m; >= K*lo*smoothstep(SEAT) with lo = min(pitch_l, pitch_r) > 0
spec.skirt_b: pitch = CAP*tanh(K*m/CAP) if m < 0 else K_IN*m; <= K*hi*smoothstep(SEAT) with hi = max(pitch_l, pitch_r) < 0
spec.skirt_l: abd = K * spread(abd(thigh_l)), K_IN if < 0; pitch = K_SIDE * pitch(thigh_l) forward, K_SIDE_BACK backward
spec.skirt_r: abd = K * spread(abd(thigh_r)), K_IN if < 0; pitch = K_SIDE * pitch(thigh_r) forward, K_SIDE_BACK backward
spec.frame: angles in the hips frame relative to rest; forward pitch = rotation about -X (Blender, char faces -Y); outward abd = tail moves away from x=0; each skirt bone rotates about its own head

driven.note: Do not key the skirt bones by hand: set them from the thighs on every pose/frame before baking. Review fix 2026-11-22 (anim fixer): centre panels driven by the MEAN thigh pitch with a soft cap, side-panel spread limited, seated clearance eased in (skirt split / crotch V fix).

notes: Coordinates: Blender, Z up, metres, character faces -Y, its left = +X; armature and mesh at identity, so bone head/tail are world positions. glTF export (+Y up) keeps each joint in the Blender bone frame (+Y along the bone), so a Godot BoneAttachment3D on the socket bone + socket_offsets (loc, XYZ euler rot_deg, in that bone frame) reproduces the placement in hercules.blend. Skeleton = Higgsfield/Meshy auto-rig renamed (Hips->hips, Spine02->spine_01, Spine01->spine_02, Spine->spine_03, neck, Head->head, Left*/Right* -> *_l/*_r); Meshy helper bone headfront merged into head, head_end dropped, root added (non-deforming, at the origin). Review fixes 2026-11-22: (1) SKIRT: four deform bones skirt_f/b/l/r (children of hips, belt z 1.12 -> hem z 0.70) own the red cloth below the belt (hips at the belt blending to the skirt bones by the hem, by geodesic distance); no thigh weight on the skirt, tunic or belt. The generated mesh glued the hem underside to both thighs with 496 faces; they were deleted (19 verts) so the skirt hangs free; the thigh tops are open inside the skirt and the material is double-sided. The skirt bones are DRIVEN, never keyed: see "driven" and skirt_drivers.py. Without the driver the skirt stays rigid with the hips and the thighs pass through it. (2) Feet: both ankles at (+-0.205, 0.070, 0.140), ball joints at (+-0.237, -0.085, 0.045); left foot/toe/lower-shin weights mirrored from the right; mirror test foot 30 deg p95 7.5 mm. (3) Skin under the skirt: no opposite-leg weight beyond a 1.2 cm centre seam; crotch seam 45/45 thighs + 10% hips. (4) Neck: right back mirrored from the left, shoulder weight ramps out above z 1.55-1.59, near-coincident vertex pairs share weights. (5) spine_03 now carries up to 45% of the upper chest (z 1.40-1.55): keying it is safe. (6) Sword at rest pitched 35 deg down and 25 deg out, flat toward the front camera, so it reads in both sheet panels; socket_offsets.hand_r matches.
